description_en: Queries recent deployment events for a service
description_zh: 查询服务近期部署事件
kebab_example: aliyun eas describe-service-event --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeServiceEvent

parameters.help_en: The page number of the service event list. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 服务事件列表的页码，默认为1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en: The number of events to display per page in a paged query. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页显示的事件数量，默认为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the service is deployed
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the service. For information about how to obtain the service name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务对应名称。如何获取服务名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412109.html
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query in UTC. Default value: 7 days ago
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始UTC时间。默认为7天前
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The format is YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss. If this parameter is not specified, the current time is used
parameters.help_zh: 查询终止时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss；不填写时默认为当前时刻
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The event type. Valid values:

Normal: normal events.
Warning: abnormal events
parameters.help_zh:
事件类型：

Normal：正常事件。
Warning：异常事件
parameters.name: event_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the service instance. For information about how to obtain the instance name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412108.html
parameters.help_zh: 服务实例的名字。如何获取实例名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/412108.html
parameters.name: instance_name

Message.description_en: The event information (a formatted JSON string)
Message.description_zh: 事件信息（格式化后的JSON字符串）

Reason.description_en: The reason for the event (information about service status changes)
Reason.description_zh: 事件原因（服务状态变化信息）

Resource.description_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

Service: service.

Pod: service instance
Resource.description_zh:
资源类型。可能取值：

Service：服务。

Pod：服务实例

Time.description_en: The UTC time when the event occurred

Type.description_en:
The event type. Valid values:
Normal: normal events.
Warning: abnormal events
Type.description_zh:
事件类型，可能值：
Normal：正常事件。
Warning：异常事件
